# ceph_role (Resource)

Manages a custom Ceph Dashboard RBAC role and its scope permissions.

~> **Warning:** Built-in roles (e.g. `administrator`, `read-only`) are system roles and cannot be managed by this resource. Removing permissions from a role the provider's account depends on can lock the provider out.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ceph_role" "pool_reader" {
  name        = "pool-reader"
  description = "Read-only access to pools and monitors"

  scopes_permissions = {
    pool    = ["read"]
    monitor = ["read"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Role name. Changing this forces a new role.
- `scopes_permissions` (Map of Set of String) Permissions keyed by security scope, e.g. `{ pool = ["read", "update"], monitor = ["read"] }`. Valid permissions are `create`, `delete`, `read`, `update`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the role.

### Read-Only

- `system` (Boolean) Whether the role is a built-in system role.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ceph_role.pool_reader pool-reader
```
